description:
For Singapore Applicants:  
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience with mobile app security, app store ecosystems, or content moderation platforms.
* Technical familiarity with LLM security evaluation, AI threat models (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), or static/dynamic code analysis tools.
* Strong data-driven mindset with experience defining and optimizing multi-objective platform metrics (safety vs. speed vs. operational cost).

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The App and Ecosystem Trust (AET) team ensures safe, secure, and trustworthy experiences across our global app ecosystem. Mokka is the core review engine that processes every app submission, update, and runtime signal to protect billions of users from security vulnerabilities, policy violations, and malicious behavior.  
  
As the Product Manager for Mokka, you will take the lead on driving the overall strategy and tactical execution of our next-generation review infrastructure. Your core mission is to bridge advanced ML-driven detection capabilities with developer velocity, ensuring our entire ecosystem remains secure without unnecessary friction.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi-year product roadmap for Mokka, the app safety review platform, to scale under submission volume increases driven by AI-assisted code generation (vibe coding).
* Architect automated static, dynamic, and LLM-assisted review pipelines that intercept modern security threats before apps reach production. Design robust defenses against emerging AI vulnerabilities, including malicious model weights, indirect prompt injection vectors, agentic permission escalation, and generative privacy leaks.
* Balance friction-free onboarding for legitimate developers with rigorous verification checks for high-risk or automated app factories.
* Partner with Operations and Policy teams to design intelligent human-in-the-loop review interfaces, leveraging generative AI assistants to speed up analyst workflows and reduce manual cognitive load.
* Partner closely with ML Research, Security Engineering, Policy Operations, and Developer Relations across global sites (US, Bangalore, London, Singapore) and drive alignment across vertical AET teams (e.g. Content, Malware)

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Experience translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and working effectively with cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong product management practices and excellent communication with Data Engineering, Analysts, Data Scientists and business stakeholders.
* Nice to have: exposure to marketing measurement (attribution, MTA, MMM), promotions or merchandising analytics, or third-party data enrichment.

This is a first-principles, high-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.

You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre and post-transaction in their journeys and turn a one-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.

* Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first-principles thinking that works for Web audience.

* Identify the highest-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.

* Work with Website P&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.

* Hands-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.

* Experience managing products across Web platforms.

Masters India IT Solutions is a growing **B2B SaaS Product Company**, serving over 1500+ large enterprises. We are proud to be **Great Place To Work – Certified™**, reflecting our commitment to building a positive, growth-oriented workplace culture.

Masters India is one of the biggest GST Suvidha Providers (GSP) appointed by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) of the Government of India since 2017. Our mission is to build intuitive software solutions that simplify complex challenges faced by businesses across industries. We are fulfilling this mission by offering tax and financial automation products to enterprises.

Masters India IT Solutions is part of the 45-year-old Masters India Group, which has a diversified presence across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Hospitality, and IT, with an aggregate turnover of INR 1000+ Crores.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.**

**This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory & Product Planning**

* **Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.**

**Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.**

* **Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.**
* **Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.**

**Domain Ownership**

* **Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.**
* **Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.**
* **Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.**

**Discovery & Execution**

* **Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.**
* **Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.**
* **Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.**

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

* **Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.**

* **Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.**
* **Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.**
* **Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management**

**Good to Have**

* **Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.**
* **Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.**
* **Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.**

**Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management**

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job profile-**

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager** to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.

Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.

You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.

**Role description**

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.

Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;

* what should be redesigned or simplified;

* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;

* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;

* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities** **-**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.

* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.

* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.

* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.

* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.

* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.

* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.

* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.

* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.

* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.

* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.

* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.

You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.

You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.

Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.

Your experience is likely to include several of the following:

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.

* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.

* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.

* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.

* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.

* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.

* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.

* Cloud-based software products.

* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.

* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.

**Qualifications Preferred** **-**

Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:

* time-series databases or time-series data products;

* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;

* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;

* APIs and SDKs;

* event-driven systems;

* data ingestion and data pipelines;

* data visualisation and analytics;

* alerting or alarming products;

* geospatial or GIS products;

* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.

**Further details-**

This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.

You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.

You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.

The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:

* What should our Timeseries product become?

* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?

* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

Join Pluang and play a part in shaping the future of investing in Indonesia.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What You Will Do** **As the Product Manager - Platform, you will work on the following initiatives and more:**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Trading Platform & Product Development**

  

* Own the roadmap for the core trading experience, including the trade page, order placement, charts and portfolio, and make it simple to use across every asset class.
  
* Work closely with engineers to build scalable features that work across crypto, US stocks, Indonesian stocks, gold and mutual funds.

* Partner with teams to streamline onboarding processes while improving user experience.

* Own and improve KPIs such as install-to-first-trade conversion, KYC approval rate, 30-day activation, feature adoption, and retention.

* Collaborate with security teams to protect user data and transactions.
  
* Work with legal teams to ensure compliance with financial regulations.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Engage with traders and users to help refine product offerings.
  
* Collaborate with marketing teams to support adoption and user growth.

**What We're Looking For** **We're seeking a passionate and driven product manager who thrives in fast-paced, innovative environments. The ideal candidate will have:****Relevant product management experience**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* 2-4 years of experience in Product Management.
  
* Prior experience with trading platforms, fintech, or financial services is preferred.
  
* Being an active investor or trader yourself is a strong plus, and can make up for no fintech experience.

* A strong belief in Pluang's mission to make investing accessible, rewarding, and impactful for all Indonesians.

description:
**Overview**

Role: **Senior Product Manager**

Grow the subscription people are glad they pay for.

With millions of active users across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and Copilot usage growing fast, consumer subscriptions are one of the largest surfaces anywhere to shape the next chapter of Microsoft's subscription business. Copilot is making Microsoft 365 more powerful every month, and that creates a rare opportunity: help more people subscribe, help subscribers discover the plan that fits them best, and invent new ways to pay for AI as it becomes part of everyday life. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own consumer monetization on mobile, a business with enormous reach where the playbook for AI subscriptions is still being written.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, and AI is reshaping what people expect from a subscription. Plans now range from core productivity to Copilot-powered and Pro experiences, and usage-based offers are opening entirely new business models. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. This is the moment to define what a world-class AI subscription business looks like.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* We earn the upgrade; we never trap people in a subscription.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if...

* You treat a paywall as a product and can explain why one trial converts and another does not.
* You are excited by inventing new ways to pay for AI, from premium tiers to usage-based packs.
* You form a view on why people pay, and change it quickly when the data disagrees.
* App store policies energize your creativity rather than limit it.
* You think in lifetime value, not just conversion, and are as comfortable modelling unit economics with finance as sketching a flow with a designer.
* You already prototype, analyze and write with AI, and want a team that expects it.

This role may not be for you if...

* You want a defined backlog handed to you.
* You measure success by features shipped rather than customers who pay and stay.
* Dark patterns tempt you.

Why join us

Few roles let you shape how millions of people experience and pay for AI in their daily lives. You will own a global subscription business across growth, economics, upgrades and new business models, with the freedom to set direction and a fast-moving, AI-native team beside you. If that excites you, we would love to meet you.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

What you will own

You own a revenue-bearing business end to end across four connected levers: subscriber growth, unit economics, upgrades and new business models. Senior here means you set the strategy and experiment roadmap across all four, navigate real platform constraints and align partners you don't manage.

* Grow subscriptions: attract and convert new Microsoft 365 subscribers on mobile through great paywalls, trials and purchase experiences on the App Store and Google Play.
* Improve unit economics: raise lifetime value and ARPU through smarter packaging, pricing and offers, and by keeping subscribers engaged and renewing.
* Lead upgrades: design upgrade experiences that help subscribers discover Copilot-powered and Pro plans at the moment the value is obvious.
* Build new business models: launch and scale consumption packs and other usage-based offers that let people buy more AI exactly when they need it.
* Partner broadly: work with engineering, design, data science, finance, pricing, legal, marketing and platform partners so every offer is bold, fair and compliant.

You will move the metrics that define a healthy subscription business: paid subscriber growth, trial conversion, upgrade rate, ARPU, lifetime value, retention and consumption revenue.

Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days

* First 30 days: understand the mobile subscriber journey end to end, from first trial to upgrade to renewal, and the economics behind it.
* By 60 days: a hypothesis-led roadmap across growth, unit economics, upgrades and consumption that partners have signed up to.
* By 90 days: first experiments live across at least two levers, with early, measurable wins.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* + Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
    - OR equivalent experience.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

**Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field AND 6+ years of product management experience shipping consumer or mobile products at scale.
  + OR a master's degree AND 5+ years.
  + OR equivalent experience.
* A track record of owning subscription outcomes such as paid conversion, upgrades, ARPU, lifetime value or retention.
* Depth in designing experiments, reading results honestly and acting on them.
* Ability to align teams without formal authority and write clear narratives for senior leaders.
* Hands-on experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing.
* Paywall design, pricing and packaging, trial optimization, or tiered and usage-based (consumption) monetization models.
* Consumer subscription experience in streaming, music, edtech, gaming or AI apps.
* Comfort with SQL and causal inference.

title: Senior Product Manager - KYC Platform
description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

At Adform, the Product Management team is the place where we take customer challenges into our hands and translate them into new opportunities and solutions, where new products, capabilities, or improvements are born, where we measure our success by our product’s success, where we keep user experience on top of our minds, where business value is our language, and where learning and doing things better is what makes us get up every day.

We are looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical mindset who enjoys working closely with backend engineering teams, navigating technical challenges, and turning product direction into well-defined development initiatives. We operate in a fast-paced, international environment where collaboration, adaptability, and continuous learning are essential. Working alongside experienced Product Managers, Product Directors, and engineers, you will contribute to some of Adform's most important product initiatives.  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with complex backend systems and technical domains such as payments, integrations, data pipelines, ETL, cloud infrastructure, analytics, and APIs. If you enjoy solving complex problems, bringing structure to ambiguity, connecting business needs with technical solutions, and seeing ideas through to delivery, this could be the right opportunity for you.

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

* Take full ownership of one or two development teams' backlogs, ensuring work is prioritized according to business objectives, product goals, and technical considerations.
* Translate product scopes into clear Epics, Features, and User Stories, ensuring requirements are sufficiently detailed, actionable, and understood by development teams.
* Work closely with engineers throughout development cycles, from initial requirement analysis and refinement to implementation, acceptance testing, and release.
* Manage Product Development cycles starting when scopes are handed over by Product
* Directors, continuing with requirement analysis, definition and grooming of Epics and User Stories, verifying against acceptance criteria, preparing user documentation, and communicating product releases
* Identify dependencies across product teams and collaborate with fellow Product Managers to ensure alignment and smooth delivery.
* Develop a strong understanding of your product domain, including its business context, technical architecture, dependencies, and customer value.
* Act as the primary link between Product Directors and Development Teams
* Plan Business Milestones according to Company priorities
* Optimize the value of the work performed by Development Teams, and strive to maximize from business value perspective on both Commercial and Technical projects

**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**

* Have proven track record of working in Product Management for at least 4+ years
* Proven experience working closely with backend engineering teams and managing technically complex products.
* Experience in one or more of the following domains: payments, integrations, ETL, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, analytics, or API gateways.
* Ability to understand technical concepts, data flows, system integrations, algorithms, and automated processes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex technical and business challenges.
* Use database queries to analyze performance indicators, evaluate experiments, etc.
* Strong understanding of Product Management and Agile methodologies, including backlog management, requirements definition, prioritization, and development processes.
* Are passionate about Product Management discipline and able to demonstrate a strong knowledge of Product Management methodologies, techniques and best practices
* Are adaptable to change and thriving in a fast-paced business environment
* Have “can-do “attitude, and passion for making things happen
* Are a great match to Adform’s guiding principles: put client value in focus, behave with decency, take ownership, care, are team player, are ambitious, and stand tall
* Have excellent verbal and written communication skills, and are fluent in English
* Are curious, informal and treat others with respect

**Stand out by having:**

* Have proven experience in AdTech industry (is a plus)
* Are certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) (is a plus)

**Our promise to you:**

* You will have the opportunity to learn and grow daily and gain exposure to modern technologies
* Opportunities to learn and work with experts from different countries, with offices around the world
* You will work with highly professional and knowledgeable colleagues who share local and global objectives
* Informal style of leadership and communication – but with the highest expectations of performance and professionalism
* You will be given challenging and unique tasks that require a creative approach to problem-solving
* You will be surrounded by a dynamic, inspiring, and international environment that also provides security
* Opportunity to take an international business trip once a year
* Brand new office
* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

* Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

* Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

* Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

* Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

* And much more – join us to explore the full experience

**Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:**

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

title: Product Manager-Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Product Management**

**Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**

**About the Role**

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.

This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next

* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness

* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact

* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders

* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale

* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized

* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows

* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap

* Support go-to-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement

* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on-prem

**Work Across the Network**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go-to for questions on your product

* Mentor and lift the product managers and associates around you, modeling strong product craft

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 6+ years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product end-to-end

* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes

* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup

* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment

* Zero-to-one product or feature launch experience

* Products, professional services, consulting, or enterprise-technology background

* Experience mentoring junior product owners

**Core Competencies**

* Owns outcomes, not just outputs

* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric

* Strong product craft and delivery discipline

* Bias to action—ships, learns, iterates

* Clear communicator with engineering, design, and stakeholders

* Data-driven, with sound judgment

**Why This Role Matters**

Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft. This role owns a product built for the US market from the ground in India—discovering what to build, shipping it as one team with engineering and design, and iterating on what clients actually use. It's where strong product managers do their best hands-on work and grow into the leaders who own portfolios next.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Technical Product Manager (TPM) for CareSelect Imaging is responsible for translating product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into clear, executable technical work and driving that work through successful delivery.

This role serves as a critical connection point between Product Management and Engineering, partnering closely with development teams in India and the U.S., as well as Architecture, QA, Operations, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The Senior TPM must be able to understand the intended business and customer outcome, translate that need into manageable technical capabilities, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and remain actively engaged through planning, development, testing, release, and post-release validation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined product execution. This individual does not need to be the solution architect or engineering lead, but must be technically fluent enough to understand system interactions, integrations, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and technical constraints; ask the right questions; challenge assumptions; and facilitate alignment between business and technical teams.

A key measure of success in this role is the ability to turn complex or sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-understood, appropriately scoped work that engineering teams can execute predictably.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Translate strategy into executable work: Partner with Product Management to translate business, customer, and product needs into well-defined capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized technical work
* Own backlog readiness and work decomposition: Break complex initiatives into manageable increments, maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, and ensure work is sufficiently defined and understood before entering development
* Partner closely with Engineering: Work day-to-day with onshore and offshore Engineering, Architecture, and QA teams to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, understand APIs, integrations, data flows, and dependencies, and resolve questions throughout development
* Drive delivery across teams: Support sprint and PI planning, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and proactively manage scope, risks, blockers, and decisions from initial definition through development and delivery
* Ensure quality and release readiness: Partner with Engineering and QA on testing, acceptance criteria, UAT, release readiness, and deployment activities, ensuring product changes meet intended business and customer outcomes
* Communicate and continuously improve: Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and release impacts while identifying opportunities to improve requirements quality, delivery predictability, and collaboration across distributed teams
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, product management, business systems analysis, or technology delivery
* Experience working directly with engineering leadership, architects, and distributed development teams
* Experience supporting PI planning, dependency management, and scaled Agile delivery
* Experience managing and prioritizing backlogs in an Agile product-development environment
* Experience partnering directly with engineering teams to clarify requirements and drive work through planning and delivery
* Experience with Agile and portfolio-management tools such as Aha, Rally, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
* Demonstrated experience decomposing complex capabilities or features into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive alignment across multiple engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand and communicate end-to-end technical concepts, including data flows, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, or enterprise systems
* Demonstrated solid facilitation, written communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and delivery risks

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, claims, prior authorization, clinical data, or managed-service platforms
* Experience operating within a scaled Agile or PI-planning environment
* Knowledge of cloud technologies, DevOps practices, integration testing, and automation
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHI

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

**Senior Product Manager**

*Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India*

**Come thrive at Tandems!** At Tandems, we’re reimagining the future of financial advice. We empower financial advisors to deliver smarter, more human guidance by combining data, empathy, and artificial intelligence. Partnering with leading financial institutions, we deploy intelligent software and AI to enhance advisor productivity and deepen client relationships - enabling firms to deliver personalized advice at unprecedented scale.

After building one of the industry’s leading Digital Wealth platforms, we’ve evolved. Today, Tandems is an AI-first company, building intelligent tools that help advisors run better meetings, anticipate client needs, and make more informed decisions. Our solutions are trusted by some of the world’s largest and most innovative financial institutions, including Wells Fargo, New York Life, Wells Fargo, Scotiabank, and Citizens.

  

**About the Team and Opportunity**

As a Senior Product Manager at Tandems, you will help lead Tandems’ next chapter by embedding AI thinking and capabilities across our suite of products and shaping how financial advisors work in the age of intelligence.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of Tandems’ transformation. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Research, and Business stakeholders to define and deliver products that blend machine learning, behavioral insights, and human-centered design.

You’ll drive innovation not only within a specific product area but also across the company, influencing how we conceptualize and integrate AI across our ecosystem, from advisor tools to client engagement and portfolio management experiences.

### **Why Work for Us**

* As a reliable and trusted financial solutions provider with expanding reach to 1 in 3 households nationwide, we believe it takes extraordinary people to disrupt decades of legacy financial practices to reimagine solutions that serve customers at scale.
* We are 100+ employees strong and steadily building. Our world-class team is growing with an industry-savvy board and strategic executive team guiding us forward.
* We offer competitive benefits that include Flexible PTO, Wellness benefit, Mobile/Internet subsidy, Employee Recognition Programs, and more!
* We are a remote-first company! We have regional hubs nationwide, with presence in 4 Countries: United States, Canada, India, and Singapore.

* We are guided by our core values: Customer Delight, Make It Happen, Think Big, and We Over Me. Read more about our core values and how we live them every day on our website here.

### **How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Shape the AI vision for advisor success:** Lead the roadmap for products that use intelligence and automation to transform the financial advice industry.
* **Infuse AI across Tandems’ ecosystem:** Partner with other Product, Engineering, and Data Science leaders to define how AI enhances user experiences and outcomes across all existing and future products.
* **Translate intelligence into action:** Work with data scientists to turn model outputs into intuitive product experiences that create measurable real-world value.
* **Champion responsible AI:** Define and advocate for principles around transparency, fairness, and explainability in every product we build.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Use data and user feedback to drive hypotheses, run experiments, and evolve features that deliver measurable advisor and business impact.
* **Collaborate broadly:** Partner across design, marketing, and customer success to ensure product experiences are cohesive, valuable, and aligned with Tandems’ mission.

### **Ideal Person for this Role**

* **5–10+ years** in a product-focused role, ideally building and shipping enterprise, B2B, or platform products at scale.
* **Systems thinker** with the ability to understand how product decisions influence data flows, adjacent teams, and end-to-end user journeys.
* **AI-curious and fluent**, comfortable discussing models, ML-driven UX patterns, and data-powered product experiences (no coding required).
* **Human-centered mindset** grounded in empathy, user research, and designing technology that enhances—not replaces—human expertise.
* **Strong analytical and research skills**, leveraging both qualitative and quantitative insights to prioritize effectively and measure impact.
* **Execution excellence**, with a track record of balancing strategy and detail, making tradeoffs, and delivering in fast-moving environments.
* **Technical curiosity,** able to dive into data models, APIs, and system architecture to understand how intelligence becomes value.
* **Data-driven and outcome-oriented**, using metrics, experimentation, and evidence to drive decisions.
* **Collaborative leadership**, with extensive experience influencing and partnering across engineering, design, data, sales, marketing, and operations.
* **Exceptional communication skills** and the ability to work effectively with remote or distributed teams; FinTech or startup experience is a plus.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Why N-able:

At N-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end-to-end platform blends AI-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.

What You'll Do:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a defined area spanning network discovery and asset monitoring, including its roadmap and delivery. Network discovery is about finding and mapping the devices and assets in a customer's environment. Asset monitoring covers monitoring for security, device health, and device observability. The two connect closely, since you can only monitor what you can see, but each is an area in its own right with its own problems, users, and roadmap. You'll work with the guidance of a Principal PM or product leadership on strategy, and you'll be trusted to run day-to-day execution on your own.

N-able PMs are full-stack PMs. You'll partner closely with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to understand how MSPs operate, how customer environments are built and monitored, the competitive landscape, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that into decisions others can act on. You'll regularly be in front of partners and customers.

Product areas at N-able are flexible. As priorities and the market evolve, the areas our PMs own can change, and your focus may shift or broaden over time. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to grow.

  

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your area across network discovery and asset monitoring, contributing to its strategy and covering the lifecycle from discovery to launch.
* Translate MSP problems around device discovery, network visibility, security monitoring of assets, device health, observability, alerting, and noise reduction into clear product requirements, epics, and user stories, and explain the tradeoffs behind them.
* Make sure what gets discovered feeds what gets monitored, so that discovery and monitoring work as a coherent experience for the technician while each keeps its own roadmap.
* Partner day to day with engineering and architecture to deliver capabilities that measurably improve discovery coverage, monitoring coverage and accuracy, time to detect device issues, time to onboard, and technician efficiency.
* Run continuous discovery with MSP partners, internal IT teams, and prospects, separating what people ask for from what they actually need.
* Track the competitive landscape (RMM, network discovery and monitoring, asset monitoring, observability, ITOM) for your area and feed it into positioning and roadmap decisions.
* Build reliability, scalability, security, performance, and ease of use into product design, particularly for monitoring at scale across many customer environments.
* Define and track success metrics for your area, such as adoption, retention, and monitoring coverage, and act when they move the wrong way.
* Work with product marketing, sales, and support on launches, enablement, webinars, and analyst or customer briefings.
* Take on new or changing product areas as priorities shift, bringing your learning and good practice with you.
* Support and informally mentor newer product managers, sharing good practice with the team.

What You'll Bring:

* 7+ years in product management, including at least 2 years on SaaS products in IT management, network management, monitoring, or related infrastructure domains.

description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Every day, Gracenote ingests data for over 100,000 channels and hundreds of streaming catalogs worldwide. It arrives through thousands of partner feeds covering linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and program metadata, in every format imaginable and changing constantly. That data powers entertainment discovery for the world's top cable, OTT, CE and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Sr. Product Manager II to own the Single Ingest Platform, the system that gets all of this data into Gracenote. Based in our Bengaluru engineering center, you will report to our Director of Product Management, Data Ingest and Delivery, and work alongside our Data Delivery Product Manager. Together you own how data enters and leaves our AI-driven metadata factory.

This is a software platform role, and the platform is a service. Teams downstream decide what to do with the data once it lands. Your job is to make sure every source is set up fast, every field we need is captured correctly, and every change reaches the platform in minutes. Speed and accuracy at scale are the whole game.

It is also a hands-on role. You will write specs yourself, work directly with engineers and Data Architects, and query the data to answer your own questions. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work, and who sees AI as the way to run thousands of feeds without thousands of manual fixes.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for the Single Ingest Platform across linear schedules, streaming and VOD catalogs, and every other source type our datasets depend on.
* Own the speed and accuracy of getting partner data into Gracenote, from onboarding new sources to processing every update.
* Drive AI innovation so ingest scales to new sources, markets and metadata types with greater speed and efficiency, without adding manual processes.
* Ensure the platform is monitored for performance and breaks, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect downstream teams.
* Run ingest as a service, translating the needs of Dataset Product Managers, metadata factory teams and Delivery into a prioritized roadmap.
* Define and publish the platform's service levels and key metrics for speed, accuracy, reliability and cost, and use them to drive decisions.
* Work effectively across a globally distributed organization, with strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US and EU stakeholders.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform, data or data integration products.
* Hands-on experience with data ingestion or integration at scale: onboarding external sources, handling format and schema changes, and monitoring data flows.
* Has applied AI or ML inside a product, not only for personal productivity. Examples include extraction, classification, anomaly detection or schema mapping. Can reason about confidence, error rates and when a human needs to step in.
* Actively uses LLMs in day-to-day product work to speed up analysis, automate repetitive PM tasks and make better decisions. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands-on IC work at a senior level. Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL and REST APIs, and able to write or LLM-assist your own Python or SQL scripts to answer product questions.
* Runs a product on a small set of input and output metrics, and delivers predictably against commitments in a structured, milestone-driven development process.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with TV and entertainment metadata, EPG data or content supply chains.
* Familiarity with industry metadata and feed standards such as CableLabs ADI, TV-Anytime, or MovieLabs MEC and Avails.
* Experience with near-real-time or event-driven data pipelines.
* Experience building partner-facing source specifications or self-service onboarding tools.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. **Role Overview**

  

This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

**Product Strategy & Ownership**

  

Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly **automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management** .
