* Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
* Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
* Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
* Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
* Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
* Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
* Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

**Commercial & Business Outcomes**

* Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
* Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
* Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, preferably within **airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations** .
* Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
* Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
* Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
* Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
* Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
* Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
* Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including **Offers and Orders** , would be beneficial.
* Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
* Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
* Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

### **What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

### **Ideal Candidate**

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

title: Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub
description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  

**Principal Product Manager IT/OT D-Hub**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

The Principal Product Manager is responsible for the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap across a specific Platform or domain and works on the hardest problems within the Platform. They make specific contributions to Product and Platform delivery by working directly with Product Squads within the Platform to ensure each product is oriented toward business outcomes that improve company performance. The Principal Product Manager partners directly with the Platform Lead and their teams to deliver. The Principal Product Manager is an expert communicator that represents the Platform by presenting to senior leaders across Bayer and externally to accelerate digital transformation and build Bayer’s reputation as a digital leading company.

Principal Product Managers apply the product management discipline to some of the hardest problems within the Platform. They ensure that products are fulfilling their primary purpose to enable users to perform tasks that create value for the company by:

* Setting strategic vision for the product to ensure the customer and their needs are at the center; and ensuring team priorities are supporting business outcomes for customer, product, technical and enabling teams. This requires continual alignment of the product strategy and objectives with customer, product, technical, and enabling teams

* Managing the product backlog, which prioritizes the work of the assigned squads, to achieve the vision and aligned strategy.

To successfully manage these areas of responsibility, Principal Product Managers must have a deep understanding of the product domain, related technology, and architecture.

  

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Product Management**

The product manager is accountable for the overall success of a product throughout its lifecycle, from conception to decommissioning. They identify domain needs, develop, and validate product concepts, and build a business case. They oversee the product's build and launch, including any sourced services; as well as ensure product availability, stability, and compliance needs are met. Product managers collaborate with various teams, including product development, marketing, finance, legal, manufacturing, operations, and sales, as needed, to ensure cohesive progress and success.

Product Managers drive agile best practices with the team to improve delivery, including continuous planning ahead of each development cycle (e.g. sprint planning) and working together to co-create user stories aligned with the product backlog prioritization. In addition to guiding the team product managers have duties like market opportunity identification, competitive analysis, sales enablement, or monitoring domain performance.

* **Stakeholder Engagement**

It is vital for the product manager to identify their key stakeholder group. Though many strong and loud opinions will be expressed, an effective product manager uses discretion to deliver their product in a way that meets the needs of users and stakeholders who will ensure value is realized for Bayer. Stakeholders should trust that the product manager not only understands their needs but will actively work to ensure their needs are met while delivering the product.

* **Product Strategy**

The product manager must provide strategic leadership with full end-to-end ownership for their assigned products throughout the entire product lifecycle. They are responsible for planning and optimizing capabilities to deliver business outcomes in the most efficient way. Product managers require strong strategic planning, decision making, and influencing skills to balance the needs of users and various stakeholders.

* **Product Discovery & Delivery**

The product manager is responsible for creating comprehensive product roadmaps, to clarify user needs and non-functional requirements. They provide product oversight by tracking and reporting progress against 90-day outcomes and overall product health (including budget responsibilities). They also plan and manage product delivery while streamlining the corresponding backlog. Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

**Purpose**

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

**Growth**

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

**Culture**

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

**Innovation**

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr Product Owner, based in Amtech India, to support product execution for our labeling ERP product line and to coordinate and support the product owners working across our labeling and corrugated ERP product lines.

On the product side, this role performs the product-management execution work for the labeling line of business in close partnership with in-market product leadership. Working with product management and market-facing stakeholders, the Senior Product Owner translates roadmap initiatives and projects into actionable development work, produces and maintains product artifacts, and drives delivery — while market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set jointly with in-market leadership.

On the coordination side, this role supports and oversees the product-owner process for the India-based team: scheduling and facilitating agile ceremonies, acting as a quality gate on product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts, and building a strong product-owner community of practice. This is a coordination and enablement role; it does not carry direct people-management responsibility.

The ideal candidate understands manufacturing operations, ERP systems, and agile product development, and is comfortable working across technical teams, product owners, and in-market product leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Execution (Labeling Product Line)**

* Perform product-management execution for the labeling product line in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Translate roadmap initiatives and projects into epics, user stories, and a well-formed backlog.

* Produce and maintain product artifacts, working with in-market leadership to close market-facing gaps.

* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes in line with roadmap direction set with in-market leadership.

* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan sprints across multiple months.

**Product Owner Coordination & Enablement (Both Product Lines)**

* Coordinate and support the product owners working across the labeling and corrugated product lines in India.

* Schedule, facilitate, and oversee agile ceremonies — Program Increment (PI) Planning, Sprint Planning, and Sprint Reviews.

* Review and act as a quality gate on the completeness and quality of PDLC artifacts.

* Build and support a product-owner community of practice — shared standards, templates, and continuous improvement.

* Help product owners grow in their craft through coaching, feedback, and shared best practices.

**Agile Development Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during sprint planning, development, and release cycles.

* Coordinate with product managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment planning.

* Participate in sprint ceremonies including planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Clarify requirements and ensure development teams understand the desired product outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work with in-market product leadership (product management and market-facing stakeholders) to align execution with roadmap and customer needs.

* Work with implementation, support, and sales teams to ensure product features align with customer needs.

* Provide product expertise for internal stakeholders and help drive continuous improvement of product capabilities.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst in a software environment, including experience leading or coordinating other product owners.

* Strong experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments and facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning.

* Experience with ERP systems.

* Strong experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining and reviewing product requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to set and uphold quality standards for product artifacts.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with distributed and in-market teams.

* Product backlog and requirements management

* Product-owner coordination and enablement

* PDLC artifact quality and standards

* Stakeholder communication across distributed teams

* Experience with manufacturing, ERP, or scheduling applications.

* Knowledge of production operations, shop floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.

* Experience working in a distributed / offshore model in partnership with in-market product leadership.

* Experience establishing or supporting a product-owner community of practice.
* Experience with tools such as Jira or similar backlog management systems.

**Why Join Amtech**

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

description:
The Opportunity

RoaDo helps shippers and logistics teams run domestic and cross-border freight on one connected platform. As a Product Manager, you'll take charge of one area of that platform. Depending on business needs at the time you join, it could be load planning, carrier sourcing and spot bidding, shipment visibility, our AI-driven control tower, digital proof of delivery, freight billing, or our export-import (EXIM) workflows. You'll partner with engineers, operations teams, and enterprise clients to turn real logistics problems into products that deliver clear business results.

Your Responsibilities

* Set the product direction and quarterly priorities for your area, and see them through to delivery

* Take full ownership of how users get work done in your module, from first sketch to everyday adoption

* Strengthen how RoaDo connects with the outside world: client ERPs, transporter systems, GPS and telematics devices, shipping lines, forwarders, customs brokers, and port terminals

* Give customers a single view of their international shipments, from factory gate to port, across the sea or air leg, and on to final delivery

* Spend regular time with exporters, importers, transporters, forwarders, and finance teams to find where work breaks down and decide what to fix first

* Write detailed requirement documents that leave little room for interpretation, and stay close to the engineering team through each sprint

* Choose the right success measures, such as usage, turnaround time, port dwell, and cost per shipment, and report on them consistently

What We're Looking For

* 3 to 5 years in product management, including at least 2 years running a B2B software product with full accountability

* Solid knowledge of road freight in India, both full-truckload and part-load, including how loads are planned, how transporters are selected, how trips are tracked, and how freight bills are settled

* Practical understanding of the truckload lifecycle: placing orders with transporters, monitoring trip milestones, handling waiting charges, and closing payments

* Good knowledge of export-import operations, including space booking, container handling at CFS and ICD, port movement, customs filing, and coordination with shipping lines and forwarders

* Comfort with core trade documents and terms such as Bill of Lading, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, Incoterms, and demurrage and detention charges

* Experience with exception alerts, live visibility, or control-tower style products will set you apart

* Able to read API docs and work through integration details with engineers, including GPS and SIM-based tracking, container tracking feeds, webhooks, and ERP connections

* A data-driven mindset: you can estimate the size of a problem, pick the metric that matters, and build a persuasive case from numbers

* Strong written communication and the ability to align engineering and business teams around a spec

How You Use AI

We give real weight to this. RoaDo PMs are expected to use AI as part of their everyday toolkit.

* You regularly use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to analyse data and find patterns in product logs, customer tickets, and call notes

* You can quickly build a working prototype or demo to test an idea before engineering time is spent

* You use AI to speed up research, produce first drafts of specs, and challenge your own assumptions early

* You think about how AI can change what our product does for customers, such as reading trade documents automatically or predicting delays, and not only how it speeds up building

Bonus Points

* Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS

* Hands-on experience with freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipping line software, or with platforms like ICEGATE, PCS, or ULIP

* Exposure to multimodal freight across road, rail, sea, and air

* Working knowledge of Mixpanel, Metabase, Jira, or similar tools
